query:
SELECT
  job,
  account
FROM
  failures
WHERE
  delivery = ?1
EXCEPT
SELECT
  failures.job,
  failures.account
FROM
  retries
  JOIN failures ON failures.job = retries.job
GROUP BY
  retries.job
HAVING
  MIN(
    EXISTS (
      SELECT
        1
      FROM
        structured
      WHERE
        structured.message = retries.message
        AND structured.ordinal = retries.ordinal
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  job
